name: Thy Word
dev: Joao Tiago Moura Pereira Cordeiro dos Santos

ios.desc:
Thy Word is an ad-free Bible app built for quiet reading, careful study, and focused listening during sermons.

---

Thy Word is and will remain:
- Free
- Ad-free
- Offline-first

No subscriptions. No upsells. No distractions.

---

Study with Depth and Clarity

Strong’s Concordance (Greek and Hebrew)
Tap words in the King James Version to see their original Greek or Hebrew meaning right where you’re reading.

Trusted Commentary
Includes John Wesley’s Notes on the Whole Bible for clear, faithful explanations.

Dictionary Lookup
Instant definitions for difficult words without leaving the text.

---

Read and Navigate Effortlessly

Tabs for fast passage switching
Open multiple passages at once and move between them instantly using tabs.
Ideal for sermons and Bible studies where verses jump back and forth.

---

Powerful, Fast Search

Search the entire Bible instantly.
- Exact phrases
- Partial matches
- Old or New Testament only

Results appear in under a second.

---

Sermon and Study Notes

Sermon Notes
Take notes as you listen and find them later by date, passage, or keyword.
Never lose a message again.

Highlighting
Highlight individual words, phrases, or entire verses in multiple colors.

---

Share Scripture, Nothing Else

Share verses cleanly without links, promotions, or branding.
Just the text and the reference.

---

Offline, Private, Peaceful

- Works 100 percent offline
- No accounts
- No tracking
- No analytics

---

Bible Translations Included

- King James Version (KJV) with full Strong’s mapping
- American Standard Version (ASV)
- World English Bible (WEB)
- Luther 1912 (German)
- Almeida Revista e Corrigida (Portuguese)

show_hn.title: Show HN: An offline, free and ad-free Bible app with study tools

quotes.text: The idea of this bible app (Thy Word) is to be completely clutter free and self contained, using absolutely no permissions from the phone other than the basic ones. Includes Strong's dictionary for hebrew and greek original, John Wesley's notes on the Bible and the ability to write, save and search for notes you take during sermons. Thy Word is and will always be free, offline and clutter free.
